output.subject: We've received your complaint about your joint checking account
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

We are so sorry for the loss of your spouse. Thank you for speaking with us about your joint checking account. We know this is an incredibly difficult time, and we're sorry for the added stress and frustration this has caused.

We have received your complaint. You told us that your joint checking account was restricted after the bank was notified of your spouse's passing, and that you need access to it as the surviving joint owner. You mentioned that you have visited our North Ardley branch three times and were given a different list of documents on each visit, and that this has still not been resolved. You've asked for access to the account and for clear, consistent information about which documents you need to provide.

A specialist team is now reviewing your complaint, and we will respond to you within 10 business days. If anything changes in the meantime, or there is more you'd like us to know, please get in touch and we will add it to your complaint.

With our sincere condolences,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Check the greeting name: in the note, the ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧ token appears after the deceased spouse's first name (Layla), so it may hold a surname or the deceased's name rather than the caller's.
Confirm the caller's correct name and how they prefer to be addressed before sending.
Draft takes no position on the substance, per ACKNOWLEDGE ONLY mode; Deposit Operations is not named.
The rep told the customer that, as surviving joint owner, only a certified death certificate is needed; confirm this is accurate before the customer relies on it.
Confirm the document checklist emailed after the call matches current requirements, so the customer does not receive yet another conflicting list.
Check the status of the rep's escalation to the North Ardley branch manager about the inconsistent information.
The customer may need urgent access to funds after a bereavement; consider whether any interim contact or support is appropriate.
The customer was very emotional on the call; the tone should stay gentle in any follow-up.
Date of death recorded in the note as 8/9; verify against the death notification on file.
